sources.title: Neural Symbolic Regression Using Deep Learning and Sparse Modeling
sources.snippet: In contrast to earlier hybrid methods like AI Feynman and neural-guided symbolic regression techniques that mix approximation with symbolic search, we suggest a fully decoupled framework where a neural network functions solely as a smooth, noise-resistant functional approximator, succeeded by an independent sparse symbolic recovery phase.
